rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice before an adjective for “overly,” “too,” or “very.”

example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 tong1 taai3 haam4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the degree is excessive.

example.english: You’re being overly harsh to people like that.
example.traditional: 你咁樣對人，真係太過分喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 deoi3 jan4 zan1 hai6 taai3 gwo3 fan6 wo3

rows.note: Use this negative construction for saying that someone is not overly or very ADJ.

example.english: I’m not overly busy today, so I can have lunch with you.
example.traditional: 我今日唔係太忙，可以同你食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 hai6 taai3 mong4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6
